title: Coexistence of dipolar and quadrupolar higher-order topology
summary: Two-dimensional higher-order topological insulators are typically classified either as dipolar or quadrupolar depending on the relevant invariant. These two classes were previously considered non-overlapping. Here we put forward an example system exhibiting dipolar and quadrupolar higher-order topology simultaneously, suggest its implementation using the arrays of laser-written evanescently coupled optical waveguides and support our conclusions by the full-wave numerical simulations.
